_doc: jap-ridewatch-audio's defaults. To change them copy this file to /var/opt/jap-ridewatch/audio.json (root's, 0644). sources: tried in order, each a smartx port and its AudioManager source id. TODO: the ids are not known yet; read every source's id, name, class and availability on the car (getListMainSources) and fill them in. A source without an id is skipped, so Listen answers nosource until then, and the service offers no Listen. A source is only used when AudioManager lists it with no connection; its availability is put back afterwards. The phone's sources (256-262, 264, 267, 268, 274, 277, 278, 291), 276, 288, 289 and the CarLifeNavigation and SpeechSink ports are refused whatever this says. player: the first command whose binary exists plays the PCM ({port}, {rate} filled in); none = no Listen. TODO: pcmio is not shipped with RideWatch and the car has no aplay; put a player at one of these paths. listenMaxS: a Listen ends after this many seconds (1-3600, default 300). The helper runs as root; the player runs as JAP_RIDEWATCH_PLAYER_AS (3911:mgu_alsa), never as root.
